listing.name: Starsector Audio Fixer
listing.summary: A small patch that addresses an issue that has existed in the game for ages.
listing.aiSummary: Fixes audio loss when the system's default audio device changes during gameplay.

description: Addresses a long-standing issue where Starsector loses all audio if the active sound device changes, such as when Bluetooth headphones disconnect. It upgrades OpenAL and uses a proxy to handle Windows audio device swaps dynamically, allowing seamless switching without restarting the game.
